03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill that builds one tool page, not a report. The page is a vibe-dashboard with a Dashboard Summary, Search, Input, Output, a JSON Format table, a Mind Map and a Glossary, plus an audio overview. You drop in a zip of a saved Autodesk Fusion product-documentation page, confirm the page URL, and the page writes structured JSON: operation > tabs > sections > settings.

Everything runs in the viewer's browser; nothing is uploaded anywhere. The JSON feeds Swami's other Fusion dashboards, mainly the fusion-cam-settings skill, which matches each exported CAM setting to its Autodesk description. A published copy already exists; its byline shows its version, so Claude points Swami to it when it is current and rebuilds it to the same link when it isn't.

Why it mattersAutodesk's help pages explain every setting of a Fusion command, but only as a web page. Turning a page into JSON once lets other dashboards quote the official description next to each setting without copying text by hand.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • Builds the PageRuns its own build_page.py straight on the vibe-dashboard template. It sets the sections, fills the Glossary, sets five categories (overview, input, output, format, reference), injects the converter script, and applies vibe-dashboard's table-fit, Search and Mind Map patches.
  • Reads the ZipA built-in zip reader (no libraries) opens the upload in the browser, skips __MACOSX/ and ._ files, and picks the .html that has a matching _files folder.
  • Finds the URLTakes the product documentation URL from the Input field, or else from the saved file's "saved from url" line or its canonical link.
  • Parses Tabs and SettingsHeadings ending in "tab settings" start a tab. Headings that match the editable list of dialog group names start a section. Every other heading becomes a setting, with its description, notes, options (Name - description bullets), details, images and captions.
  • Guesses ControlsSets controlGuess for each setting (dropdown, checkbox, selection, number or unknown) from its description.
  • ImagesRecords each image by its file name, flags images the zip lacks, and can embed them as data URIs when that box is ticked.
  • OutputShows counts, a structure preview (tab, section, settings) and the JSON, with copy and download buttons. Download needs the artifact's downloads capability; without it the button hides and copy still works.
  • JSON FormatA table on the page lists every field the JSON holds, level by level, from the operation down to each setting's options and images.
  • Search, Mind Map, Glossary, AudioLike every vibe-dashboard, the page has a Search section, a Mind Map, a 15-term Glossary and a spoken audio overview.
  • JSON from ChatIf Swami sends a zip in chat and wants the JSON now, Claude runs the page headlessly on it and sends <operation>-settings.json.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • PrivateConverts entirely in the browser; the zip never leaves the computer.
  • Any Help PageWorks on any Fusion help page saved as Webpage, Complete; tested on the Parallel Finishing page (5 tabs, 14 sections, 74 settings, 67 images).
  • Adjustable GroupsThe dialog group-name list is editable, so a wrong grouping can be fixed and converted again on the spot.
  • ReusableThe published page is a lasting tool; it doesn't need rebuilding for each operation.
  • Easy to Find ThingsSearch, the Mind Map and the Glossary make the page's instructions and JSON fields quick to find.
  • Groups Are GuessedThe help page doesn't say which dialog group a setting sits in, so sections come only from headings that match the group-name list. For example, Parallel's Leads and Transitions settings land in Linking.
  • No Dialog ValuesExample values shown only in screenshots aren't extracted.
  • Control TypescontrolGuess is a guess from the description text.
09Scheduled TasksRUNTIME▶

None. The skill doesn't need, create or get run by a scheduled task. Its page is backed up nightly like every other artifact, and the nightly Skill Library refresh packages the skill as a zip.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Webpage, CompleteSave the page as Webpage, Complete, not HTML only, or the _files folder of images is missing. Safari has no such option (it saves a web archive), so use Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Comet.
  • Zip BothThe zip must hold the .html file and its _files folder together.
  • Missing GroupsIf settings land in the wrong section, add the missing group name to the list in Input and convert again.
  • No URLIf neither the field nor the saved file gives a URL, the status line warns; add it and convert again.
  • Download ButtonThe download button shows only when the page is published with the downloads capability; otherwise use copy.
  • Check the VersionThe tool page's byline shows its version (v1.1.0 after this update). If your saved link shows an older one, ask Claude to republish it.
  • Old BrowsersUnzipping needs DecompressionStream; a current Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox has it.
  • Windows DownloadsOn Windows the saved page lands in C:\Users\<name>\Downloads unless you choose another folder.
